what: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] Retain-or-rewrite options conflict with adding the same paths to migrated-scripts.tsv
scenario_or_breakage: If any listed harness or .md contract file is retained while its path is appended to python/migrated-scripts.tsv, make lint-retired-scripts fails because retired paths may not remain on disk
suggested_fix: Make deletion mandatory for every path appended to python/migrated-scripts.tsv, or omit any retained path from the manifest. Prefer deletion per the migration recipe
